text:
Hi All. I'm just writing for emotional support and because it feels safe to ask in this group. It doesn't necessarily have to do with the PIBA process but with what it feels like to be a non-Jewish or brown-skinned immigrant in Israel. I wonder if it feels this bad specifically because of who is in charge of the Population Authority. How long has it been since the people in charge were not super right wing religious? And are any of the viable parties now running for Knesset representation considering a change in outlook and policy? Do we know what party would be more friendly to the immigrant population here? 
Feeling sad today.
